audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Yasuo rows 0, 1, 2, 4 and 6 at 8/10 while every explanation beside those rows says the opposite — whys[0] "out-trade your crit-less level 1", whys[1] "Level 2 stays his", whys[2] "chunks you on every step-up", whys[3] "remain his", whys[4] "floods ghouls and shoves you off the wave". Row 5 read "Skill" while whys[5] says first item is where you turn on him. All seven phases[].why bodies were generic Yasuo-favourable boilerplate.
audit.why: The packet chart, whys, spikes, early, mid and late all agree on the same arc: Yorick owns levels 1-6, Yasuo owns both item brackets. A 55.5% win rate earned entirely from the first crit item onward is consistent with that.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-5 flipped in BOTH layers as one atomic group (Yorick x5, then Yasuo) with ratings moved, and all six stage explanations rewritten to name the mechanic that owns each row.

audit.whatIsWrong: Not one cooldown appeared anywhere on the page, so "track Dark Procession" and "don't fight into Maiden" had no timers attached.
audit.why: Dark Procession is 20/18/16/14/12s, Mourning Mist 12/11/10/9/8s, Last Rites 6/5.5/5/4.5/4s, Eulogy of the Isles 160/130/100s. The 160-second ultimate in particular is why waiting Maiden out is a real plan rather than a platitude.
audit.corrected: The rewritten stage explanations and do/don't bodies now carry the rank-1 numbers for W, E, Q and R.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three do/don't bodies were boilerplate unrelated to their titles, and nothing recorded that Last Rites is an auto-attack reset that heals him, or that Dark Procession is destructible terrain rather than a stun-style cage.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags needs-antiheal and autoreset-burst-tell, both on Last Rites (6s at rank 1). Dark Procession's terrain flag matters specifically because it blocks Sweeping Blade's exit, and it can be broken. Wind Wall blocking Mourning Mist is already correctly stated on the page — E is the one Yorick ability carrying the projectile flag — and was left as-is.
audit.corrected: dosFull[1].d gives the Last Rites reset, its 6s and Grievous Wounds; dosFull[2].d gives Dark Procession's 20s and that it is destructible; dontsFull[1].d gives the 160s Maiden cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: packet.suspectNames flags "Mourning Mist's" in whys[2] as a probable wrong ability name.
audit.why: False positive — Mourning Mist is Yorick's real E. No edit made.

edits.before: Stack tornado through the wave; your passive shield eats one poke for free. Identify how Yorick contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: His Mist Walkers auto you while Mourning Mist pokes and you have no crit yet — last-hit only what is safe and give up the rest without a fight.

edits.before: E dashes through minions make you untouchable in the wave. Only take the trade when Yorick's Dark Procession is down.
edits.after: The swarm plus the Mourning Mist slow keeps you off CS — dash through minions to farm, not to trade with him.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Yorick must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Mourning Mist (12s at rank 1) marks you and speeds his ghouls in — wall the globule or don't step up at all.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Dark Procession's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Dark Procession (20s at rank 1) is destructible terrain that cages your dash — farm safe, bank CS, wait on your crit item.

edits.before: Last Breath converts ANY knockup into a kill window. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Yorick's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Eulogy of the Isles floods ghouls and shoves you off farm — don't duel into Maiden; reset or roam and let the wave crash.

edits.before: Blade of the Ruined King is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Dark Procession's cooldown.
edits.after: Crit online, your Q sweeps his ghouls instantly — the lane turns here, on Dark Procession's 20 seconds.

edits.before: Dash through the wave stacking Q, tag Yorick with Q2, and only commit the EQ3 knockup when his answer is down.
edits.after: Last Rites is an auto reset on 6s that heals him — the wind-up is your cue, and Grievous Wounds blunts it.

edits.before: Yorick wastes Dark Procession (Cage) — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Dark Procession is 20s at rank 1 and destructible — break it or walk wide.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Eulogy of the Isles is 160s at rank 1 — wait it out, never into it.

notes: No mirror existed; this page sets the shape yorick__yasuo must invert (rows 0-4 Yorick, rows 5-6 Yasuo). The packet flags the chart as contradicting a 55.5% win rate, but every prose field describes a lane lost early and won from the first crit item, which is consistent with that number — so the packet's own chart was followed rather than rebalanced. Page-level inconsistency left alone: diff says EVEN while tone, diffRating 8.5/10 and report[14] all say hard.
